name: extension_workshop
description: Unified extension facade - author, deploy and inspect configuration extensions. Authoring: create_extension_project (new extension from a base configuration), borrow_object, borrow_objects (batch), borrow_child, borrow_form_item, borrow_module, list_borrowed, update_borrowed (resync with the base). Deployment (into a project's infobase): install_extension, uninstall_extension, list_extension, export_extension. Inspection: extension_lifecycle, extension_diff, list_interceptors, check_release_fitness, check_platform_verdict. The deploy / inspect operations route to the matching standalone tools, which remain available. dryRun is not supported for the authoring operations; when the EDT adopt service is not reachable the response carries `adoptServiceNotFound` with a GUI workaround hint.

operation.description: create_extension_project / borrow_object / borrow_objects / borrow_child / borrow_form_item / borrow_module / list_borrowed / update_borrowed / install_extension / uninstall_extension / list_extension / export_extension / extension_lifecycle / extension_diff / list_interceptors / check_release_fitness / check_platform_verdict / help

projectName.description: Extension project name. For create_extension_project this is the NEW extension's name (must not already exist); for borrow_* it is the existing extension to borrow into.

baseProjectName.description: Base configuration project. Required for create_extension_project; for borrow_* and update_borrowed defaults to the extension's parent.

namePrefix.description: create_extension_project: optional object name prefix for the new extension (applied to its Configuration). Omit to keep the EDT default.

objectFqn.description: FQN to borrow; update_borrowed: the one object to review. Top-level: Catalog.Name. Child: Catalog.Name.Form.FormName, Document.Name.Attribute.AttrName, Document.Name.TabularSection.TsName, Catalog.Name.Template.TplName, Catalog.Name.Command.CmdName, InformationRegister.Name.Dimension.DimName, InformationRegister.Name.Resource.ResName. Russian child-kind aliases accepted.

objectFqns.description: Array of FQNs for borrow_objects batch

runKey.description: borrow_objects: a large batch can exceed the soft timeout and return a Pending status with a runKey - re-call borrow_objects with the same objectFqns and this runKey to fetch the final per-FQN batchResults.

cancel.description: Creation + runKey: cooperative cancel; never deletes projects.

childName.description: borrow_child: the child's name when objectFqn names the owner; read when name is not given.

name.description: borrow_child: the child's name; childName is read when this is not given.

itemName.description: borrow_form_item: the item you mean to change. The item itself is not borrowed - the form is, and the item is then yours to change.

formName.description: borrow_form_item: which form, when objectFqn names the owner rather than the form.

includeChildren.description: borrow_object: also borrow that object's own children. Default false.

apply.description: update_borrowed: write the alignments. Default false - review only.

moduleType.description: borrow_module: ObjectModule / ManagerModule / RecordSetModule / CommandModule / ValueModule

extensionName.description: Deployed extension name for install / uninstall / export_extension.

inputPath.description: install_extension: source of the .cfe - a local file path, an http(s):// URL, or a github:/gh: release reference.

outputPath.description: export_extension: path to write the extracted .cfe to.

applicationId.description: install / uninstall / list / export_extension: target infobase application id (omit for the project default).

updateDatabase.description: install_extension: run the infobase configuration update after install. Default true.

targetFqn.description: extension_lifecycle: the object/method the workflow acts on.

eventName.description: extension_lifecycle: the extension event to generate a handler for.

mode.description: extension_lifecycle: execution mode - full / dryRun / probeOnly.

configurationFile.description: check_platform_verdict: the delivery as a .cf. It is loaded into a staging infobase created for this run; the working infobase is not opened, locked or altered.

extensionFile.description: check_platform_verdict: the extension as a .cfe, put to the platform against the delivery above.

loadAs.description: check_platform_verdict: the name to load the extension under. Omit and the file name is used - which the answer reports back as loadedAs. The platform matches an extension to a configuration by content, so the name does not change the verdict.

platform.description: check_platform_verdict: platform version to run (for example 8.3.27.1234). Omit for the newest installed. A delivery built for an older platform is refused by a newer one, so name the version it was built for.

topic.description: Help topic when operation=help. Without topic - lists all operations.
